markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (92%)** · Confident · Careful review
Conformal set holds Invasive only; margin call is tumor at superior and lateral margins [F7].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 92%, InSitu 8% | Clear lead |
| Conformal set | Invasive only (90% level) | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.999 / 1.0 | Not flagged |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Yes | Same top class |
| Similar cases | 5 of 5 Invasive | Unanimous neighbors |

## Tissue evidence
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (regions 7, 10, 11) · ↑ invasive · Strongest concept association with invasive carcinoma [F2] · Validated
- **Marked nuclear pleomorphism** (regions 5, 7, 11) · ↑ invasive · Second-strongest association; scored above typical [F3] · Validated
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (regions 1, 5, 11) · ↑ invasive · Score high, but failed AI spot check (0/20) [F4] · Unreliable
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 10) · ↓ invasive · Low score; in-situ pattern not prominent · Weak

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Removing the top 3 regions cuts the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47 to 0.60); faithful.
- **Concepts**: Deletion effect 0.002 (CI −0.005 to 0.007) includes 0, so unproven; mitoses is Unreliable here.

## Could be wrong if
- The input is a simulated, JPEG-degraded frozen section; the reliability score only moderately predicts errors (AUROC 0.69).
- In situ disease (8%) is not excluded; the duct-confined concept is only Weak (12/20).

## Check on the slide
1. **7, 10, 11**: Confirm tumor infiltrating stroma; compare region 10 against in-situ ducts.
2. **5, 7, 11**: Confirm marked pleomorphism; count mitoses by eye, as the score is unreliable.
3. **2, 7, 11**: Inspect superior and lateral edge strips for tumor at the margin.
